newsitem.title: FRANCE: Poliet provisional 1996 net attrib rises.
newsitem.headline: Poliet provisional 1996 net attrib rises.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
of which second half 495 vs not given
of which second half 552 vs not given

"The 1996 second half result, 495 million francs, showed a sharp improvement from that of the first half, 300 million francs, due to an increase in activities and measures taken to adapt to the economic situation," Poliet said in a statement.
The consolidated net result was up 5.8 percent over the year earlier level, while net attributable rose 5.7 percent.
Sales were up 1.4 percent, or 0.3 percent at constant structure and exchange rates, Poliet said. New acquisitions contributed 300 million francs to sales.
The definitive results will be published on March 18.
